categories_thin: Environmental consulting / remediation — 3 located after a dedicated LSRP/environmental search (Sage ATC, Geo-Enviro, EcoTerra). Most firms serving Piscataway sit in Edison, Somerset or North Brunswick. Prestige Environmental Inc. was NOT added: its only Piscataway address appeared on a Yellow Pages page, while chamber and state vendor records show 220 Davidson Ave, Somerset.
Title agencies — only 2 in town (North East Title, Consumers Title); most Central Jersey title agencies are in Edison or New Brunswick.
Land surveying — 1 Piscataway-based firm (Brunswick Surveying). A second name appeared only on a Yellow Pages land-surveyor page, which has been unreliable here, so it was not added.

Architecture — 1 confirmed sole practice (Steve J. Druga) plus Avoca's architecture work. Firms that surfaced by search (PK Architecture, John Saracco) serve Piscataway from other towns or show project references only, not a local office.

Real estate appraisal — 2 entries, both at shared/virtual suites. Two further appraiser names surfaced only at residential street addresses and were not added (home offices, not visitable businesses).
Staffing — 5 independent firms. National chains with Piscataway offices (Randstad, Aerotek, Kelly) are excluded as chains.
caveats: Removed this round: The Food Architects (a food/catering and cafe business — excluded type, wrong category, wrong address; its only source was a Yellow Pages 'architectural engineers' category page, now treated as unreliable for this zone); Primerica (brand-franchised financial services, treated like the State Farm/Allstate/Nationwide/Travelers agency offices already excluded); Law Offices of Jonathan F. Marshall (its 'Piscataway office' page is a service-area page with no street address and the firm's contact page lists no Piscataway address, so it was removed rather than parked as a local office — treat it as a service-area competitor, not a local business).

Source quality: roughly 70 of the 118 entries below still rest only on a Google Maps category search or a bulk directory rather than a per-business page. Each such row says so in active_evidence and notes; they should not enter an outreach queue until someone opens a business-specific page (own site, state licence record, chamber profile or per-business directory listing). Rows with an own website, township/chamber profile, carrier agent page or professional-association profile are already business-specific.

Shared-office flags: every Suite 525 row at 30 Knightsbridge Rd and every Suite 200 row at 371 Hoes Ln is flagged in notes. That pattern looks like a shared/virtual office or mail-drop suite; the businesses may be real, but the address is not evidence of a staffed local office. Same caution for the 15 Corporate Place South and 200 Centennial Ave clusters, which host many small consulting/IT firms.

Corrections made this round: Consumers Title Agency moved from 216 Stelton Rd to 30 Knightsbridge Rd Suite 525 (per the firm's own contact page); Mavinkurve & Patel phone changed to the number its own site publishes; Clarity & Wealth / Clarity & Synergy / Patel Home Finance / Edge Home Finance rows merged so one firm or adviser is not counted twice.

Red Door Real Estate has no website recorded: the previously listed domain did not resolve when checked, so it was blanked rather than cited. The business itself is confirmed by the township profile and by map and realtor.com listings.
Two phone numbers were set to Unknown because only a partial number was visible: The Elmer D. Arroyo Home Selling Team and Computer Management Corporation.

Google Maps in a visitor browser returned a capped 'limited view' of about five rows per query with no outbound website links, so coverage leans on many narrow keyword queries plus directories. Businesses that Maps surfaces only under a keyword not tried, or below the first few rows of a category, may still be missing.

Excluded as national/regional chains or brand franchises: H&R Block, TurboTax offices, B. Riley Wealth, State Farm/Allstate/Nationwide/Travelers agency offices, CMIT Solutions, RE/MAX Home Pros, Coldwell Banker, ERA Boniakowski, Randstad, Aerotek, Kelly Services, uBreakiFix, AECOM, Virtusa, Synechron, Digital Realty, plus banks and credit unions. Also out of scope for group A: the township's health, fitness, retail, hospitality, food, pest-control, laboratory and manufacturing members.

Several map listings carry non-local area codes (Michigan, Iowa, Wisconsin, San Diego, California, New York) — common for staffing and consulting branch offices, or possibly mobile numbers; flagged in notes.
data_gaps: Yellow Pages, BBB, Justia, Manta, AllPages, Cylex, find-open and chamberofcommerce.com returned HTTP 403 / bot checks to both fetch and the browser, so those bulk directories could not be mined systematically.
Overpass API (OpenStreetMap) was unreachable on earlier attempts, so no OSM cross-check of office=* features was possible.
Piscataway Township publishes no licensed-business list online; only the opt-in Piscataway Business Partnership directory is available, and most of its profile pages carry no address or phone.

Middlesex County Regional Chamber category pages render member names in fields the text extraction drops, so the name-to-address pairing for Flaherty Solutions and Clarity Accounting & Tax Group relies on the chamber listing index and needs a visual check.
google.com/maps in the visitor browser showed a capped five-result 'limited view' without outbound website links, limiting per-business URL capture.

consumerstitlesagency.com could not be fetched (TLS certificate error in the browser, fetch failure), so the corrected title-agency address comes from a search result quoting that same contact page. pmaconsultants.com/offices/newark/ 404'd on direct fetch, so that office address is also quoted from a search result.
Headcount for Edgewood Properties and PMA Consultants is unestablished; both should be checked against the 500-staff cutoff before outreach.

Geo-Enviro's street number cannot be settled: its own site publishes no address, LinkedIn gives 372 Hoes Ln and a directory gives 371. Prestige Environmental could not be confirmed at any Piscataway address (chamber and state vendor records show a Somerset HQ).
